original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州一大学讲师在酒店身亡，警方逮捕三人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州警察局已逮捕三人，此前安布罗斯·阿利大学埃克波马分校的高级讲师马修·乌乌伊格贝被发现死于当地一家酒店房间。据PM News报道，该讲师据称雇佣了一名21岁性工作者安吉拉·德法·雅各布，后者据称陪同其前往该场所。警方称被捕者为酒店老板、经理及该21岁女子。目前信息为单一来源，相关指控尚未获独立证实。

location.raw_text: a hotel in the Mosco area of Ekpoma, Esan West Local Government Area of Edo State

key_facts.fact: 埃多州警察局在安布罗斯·阿利大学讲师马修·乌乌伊格贝死于埃克波马酒店房间后逮捕三人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Edo State Police Command has arrested three people after a senior lecturer at Ambrose Alli University, Ekpoma, Matthew Uwuigbe, was found dead in a hotel room in the town.

key_facts.fact: 据PM News报道，该讲师据称雇佣了一名21岁性工作者安吉拉·德法·雅各布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to PM News, Uwuigbe was said to have engaged the services of a 21-year-old sex worker, Angela Defa Jacob, who allegedly accompanied the lecturer to the facility.

key_facts.fact: 警方称讲师于2026年10月5日在埃克波马Mosco地区一家酒店被发现无生命体征
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the lecturer was found lifeless on Monday, October 5, 2026, at a hotel in the Mosco area of Ekpoma, Esan West Local Government Area of Edo State.

key_facts.fact: 被捕三人为酒店老板、经理及21岁女子安吉拉·德法·雅各布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: those arrested are the hotel owner, the manager, and a 21-year-old woman identified as Angela Defa Jacob, who was reportedly in the room with the lecturer shortly before his death.

uncertainties: 讲师雇佣性工作者的说法为据称，尚未获独立证实
目前仅单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
